title: fastProject 4.11.1 Released
author: Mark Edmonds
content:
General

  • NEW FEATURE: You can now Breakdown a task using the tasks that were stored in the notes from an “Undo breakdown”. If you want to roll-up a task’s subtasks back into a single task and copy the tasks into the notes, then one can perform an “Undo breakdown”. In the past, this simply stored the tasks in the notes. However, this has been recently expanded such that if you breakdown a task that has previously had a “Undo breakdown” performed, then it will take those tasks and recreate the WBS. Points to note: It only works on “Undo breakdowns” performed using this release of the software You cannot edit the notes when breaking down (do not manually edit the WBS in the notes) If a started task was “Unbroken”, when it’s broken down, the first task is used to adjust the %complete Includes Targets, Touchpoints, Checkpoints and Deliverables and their dates
